## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Yào jiě* in 1 fascicle is the late-Míng commentary on the *[Smaller Sukhāvatī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0082)* by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) *Ǒuyì Zhìxù* 蕅益智旭 (1599–1655), one of the *Four Great Masters of the Late Míng*. It is one of the most influential single Pure Land commentaries in late-imperial Chinese Buddhism and remained the standard introductory text in subsequent Chinese Pure Land study.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1620 – 1655) reflects [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Ǒuyì Zhìxù's mature scholarly period leading up to his death.

The Taishō text (T1762) is established on the standard apparatus.
